normative_extracts.quote: Write operations require transient user activation or explicit clipboard-write permission in a secure context; readText() additionally requires focused document and user gesture or permission.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The browser gates OS pasteboard IPC behind HTTPS, document focus, and a decaying transient activation token, re-encoding images to strip exploit payloads.

production_failures.symptom: NotAllowedError: Write permission denied when copying a link after an async API call
production_failures.root_cause: Awaiting a slow fetch() before calling navigator.clipboard.writeText() expires Safari's strict transient user activation window.
production_failures.mitigation: Call navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({ 'text/plain': fetchPromise.then(t => new Blob([t], { type: 'text/plain' })) })]) synchronously inside the click handler.

production_failures.symptom: document.execCommand('copy') silently fails in headless or modern async flows
production_failures.root_cause: Legacy execCommand mutates DOM selection synchronously and is deprecated with inconsistent permissions.
production_failures.mitigation: Migrate to navigator.clipboard.writeText() / write() with ClipboardItem Promise values.
